product_metadata.title: HOMLYNS Electric Heated Mattress Pad King Size Dual Control 10 Heating Levels 1-12H Timer,Sherpa Quilted Zoned Heating Mattress Pads Machine Washable ETL Certified,15" Deep (78x80)
features: DUAL CONTROLLERS & FAST HEATING - Equipped with 10 heat settings and 2 LCD controllers,this king heated mattress pad serves couples individually with customizing temps on both sides and heats up fast.
AUTO-OFF TIMER & OVERHEAT PROTECT - Our electric mattress pad is certified by ETL & FCC to ensure safety and is equipped with 1-12 hours auto-off timer.
QUILTED FLUFFY SHERPA FLEECE- This king size heating pad provide you extra warm in winter days and the stretchy skirt fits to 15'' mattress.
EXTRA LONG CORD - With 19.2ft long detachable power cord for the controllers,it enables you with more flexibility to reach.
MACHINE WASHABLE - To maintain the hygienic and durable use of the heated mattress pads, it is recommended to wash on gentle cycle and hang to dry after removing all cords.
